title: Ngeli ya I-ZI (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of I-ZI (often n- nouns like nyumba, meza, kalamu) keep one form and take i- for one and zi- for many.
steps: Notice it does not change in the plural.
contexts: time and seasons (saa na majira): clocks

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Saa imesimama" and "Saa zimesimama".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nyumba moja ___meanguka." Kwa nini "zi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nyumba moja ni umoja. Kiambishi cha umoja cha ngeli ya I-ZI ni i-: nyumba imeanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nyumba nyingi ___meanguka." Kwa nini "i" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za I-ZI zina umbo moja katika umoja na wingi. Maneno mengine ya sentensi, kama "nyingi", yanaonyesha ni wingi, kwa hiyo tunatumia zi-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Meza mbili ___mevunjika." Kwa nini "vi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Si kila kitu hutumia ki-/vi-. Meza, nyumba na barabara ni za ngeli ya I-ZI, kwa hiyo wingi hutumia zi-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "Nyumba ni kubwa" ni ___." Kwa nini "Manyumba ni makubwa." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za I-ZI haziongezi kiambishi katika wingi. Tunabadilisha viambishi vya upatanisho: nyumba zote ni kubwa.
